_notes: Named rares of Glittervein. One item per kill. Hand-authored in tools/build_glittervein_content.py; spread and resistance placement checked by its audit().

Thirstjaw.name: Thirstjaw's Hooked Fang
Thirstjaw.flavor_text: It waits at the lip, where the tired come up.

Thirstjaw.name: Lip-of-the-Hole Hauberk
Thirstjaw.flavor_text: Everything that climbs out of there climbs out slowly.

Thirstjaw.name: Rimwatcher's Cowl
Thirstjaw.flavor_text: You can see the whole pan from up there and none of it is worth watching.

Thirstjaw.name: Dry Rim Pendant
Thirstjaw.flavor_text: Forty-six feet above the only water for a hundred miles.

Old Riser.name: Riser's Stepping Maul
Old Riser.flavor_text: The terraces are steps and something has been walking up them for a long time.

Old Riser.name: Terrace-Warden Greaves
Old Riser.flavor_text: Crystal dust in every seam of them, and it does not brush out.

Old Riser.name: First-Terrace Jerkin
Old Riser.flavor_text: Whatever is on that bench has had the run of it for years.

Old Riser.name: Old Riser's Tooth
Old Riser.flavor_text: Worn flat on one side from going up the same stone.

Shatterlight.name: Shatterlight Prism-Rod
Shatterlight.flavor_text: Hold it up in the galleries and the walls answer.

Shatterlight.name: Split-Beam Mantle
Shatterlight.flavor_text: The light in those galleries comes from the stone and goes where it likes.

Shatterlight.name: Gallery-Walker's Grips
Shatterlight.flavor_text: Everyone who works the seams loses the pads off their fingers.

Shatterlight.name: Refracted Scale Coif
Shatterlight.flavor_text: Looks like four of itself in the right light.

Rootbound.name: Rootbound's Creeping Limb
Rootbound.flavor_text: Six feet of green that has had three years and no winter.

Rootbound.name: Greenshelf Breastplate
Rootbound.flavor_text: Rust would be easier. This has something growing in the rivets.

Rootbound.name: Damp-Band Bracers
Rootbound.flavor_text: The only band on that wall where anything is alive.

Rootbound.name: Fern-Shadow Slippers
Rootbound.flavor_text: Quiet, on the one part of the hole that has leaf litter.

Stillwater.name: Stillwater's Drowning Spear
Stillwater.flavor_text: Cold all the way through, in a desert, at the bottom of a hole.

Stillwater.name: Waterline Scale Girdle
Stillwater.flavor_text: The mark round the rock where the pool used to stop.

Stillwater.name: Unmoving-Pool Guards
Stillwater.flavor_text: Nothing on that water moves. Not even the surface.

Stillwater.name: Deep-Still Treads
Stillwater.flavor_text: The only standing water for a hundred miles and it stands very still.
